notes.subject: don
notes.rationale: Bamanankan n'a fɔ-kuma ka kelen-cogo ka wajibi; Heburukan ma a sɔrɔ — הזה ('in') bɛ jira, nka copula tɛ

notes.subject: kasa
notes.rationale: מרעיש ka kɔrɔ tiɲɛ ye 'ka ... jɛ / ka latigili' ye; 'kasa' (kɛgɛya) taara a nɔ, sabu Bamanankan ka jamana 'jɛli' daɲɛ nɔgɔman tɛ

notes.subject: מרגיז/מרעיש
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ fila ninnu bɛ taamasiyɛn ɲɔgɔn fɛ (מרגיז–מרעיש), paronomasia min bɛ ŋwɔ Bamanankan na

notes.subject: Babilɔn ka masakɛ bɛɛbɛɛyɔrɔ
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ fɔ masakɛ sumun ma — 'i' nɔnabila fila, mɔgɔ minnu ye a ye u bɛ a ɲɛsinkiri

translation: Mɔgɔw minnu b'i ye, u bɛ i ɲɛsinkiri, u bɛ i hakilila, u b'a fɔ ko: yala cɛ in ⟨don⟩ min ye dugukolo latigili, min ye masakɛyaw ka jamana kasa?
